description: This Java class wraps the TextWatcher interface to delegate only the afterTextChanged event to a custom listener, effectively hiding other TextWatcher events.

classes.name: TextWatcherWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for the TextWatcher interface that delegates only the afterTextChanged event to a specified listener.

methods.name: TextWatcherWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with an identifier and a listener.

methods.name: beforeTextChanged
methods.description: Override of TextWatcher method; intentionally ignored in this wrapper.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Override of TextWatcher method; intentionally ignored in this wrapper.

methods.name: afterTextChanged
methods.description: Delegates the event to the registered listener's onTextChanged method with the string content.
